name: stm_material_advantage_two_or_more
description: The side to move has at least two points more total piece value (pawn=1, knight/bishop=3, rook=5, queen=9) than the opponent.
source:
MOTIF_NAME = 'stm_material_advantage_two_or_more'
MOTIF_DESCRIPTION = 'The side to move has at least two points more total piece value (pawn=1, knight/bishop=3, rook=5, queen=9) than the opponent.'
import chess

def motif(fen: str) -> bool:
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    stm = board.turn
    vals = {
        chess.PAWN: 1,
        chess.KNIGHT: 3,
        chess.BISHOP: 3,
        chess.ROOK: 5,
        chess.QUEEN: 9,
    }
    s = 0
    o = 0
    for sq in chess.SQUARES:
        p = board.piece_at(sq)
        if p is None or p.piece_type == chess.KING:
            continue
        v = vals[p.piece_type]
        if p.color == stm:
            s += v
        else:
            o += v
    return s - o >= 2
